Yampil Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Yampil suffered a blood libel accusation in 1758, resolved through the intervention of Cardinal Lorenzo Ganganelli — later Pope Clement XIV, known historically for his investigation debunking ritual-murder accusations — and Pope Benedict XIV. In late July 1941, Romanian forces deported thousands of Bukovina Jews across the Dniester into the Yampil area without coordinating with the Germans, who held the stranded deportees near the town's bridge for several days before most were murdered by Einsatzgruppe D and Romanian army units; the concentration area for these Jews stood directly opposite this cemetery. Established in the early 18th century, this is the older of Yampil's two Jewish cemeteries.
